cases.title: Validate deadline and event input
cases.aim: Verify required descriptions, delimiters, and date or time values for deadline and event commands.
cases.setup: Start Nudge with an empty task list.

expect.text: A deadline needs a description. Try: deadline DESCRIPTION /by yyyy-MM-dd
A deadline needs `/by` before its due date. Try: deadline DESCRIPTION /by yyyy-MM-dd
A deadline needs a date after `/by`. Try: deadline DESCRIPTION /by yyyy-MM-dd
The deadline date must be a valid date in yyyy-MM-dd format.
An event needs a description. Try: event DESCRIPTION /from yyyy-MM-dd /to yyyy-MM-dd
An event needs `/from` before its start time. Try: event DESCRIPTION /from yyyy-MM-dd /to yyyy-MM-dd
An event needs `/to` before its end time. Try: event DESCRIPTION /from yyyy-MM-dd /to yyyy-MM-dd
An event needs a start date after `/from`. Try: event DESCRIPTION /from yyyy-MM-dd /to yyyy-MM-dd
An event needs an end date after `/to`. Try: event DESCRIPTION /from yyyy-MM-dd /to yyyy-MM-dd
The event start date must be a valid date in yyyy-MM-dd format.
The event end date must be a valid date in yyyy-MM-dd format.
Okay, I'll leave you to it. I'll be here if you need another nudge!
